name: ashui-icons
description: The Remix icon set as typed ashui constants, compiled into a program, with the macro that makes a set from any directory of SVG files.
releasenote: Remix Icon 4.8.0 (3188 icons, Apache-2.0) as ashui.icons.Remix, and ashui.svg.IconSet for sets of your own. Uses ashui 0.1.5.
